definitions: A written or oral statement made by the victim of a crime, or by a family member of the victim, during the sentencing phase of a trial.
A statement presented in court that describes the psychological, physical, and financial impact of a crime on the victim.
examples: The judge considered the victim impact statement before handing down the sentence.
She bravely read her victim impact statement in court, detailing the trauma she endured.
The prosecution submitted a comprehensive victim impact statement on behalf of the family.
